title: spiranthes trilineata var. thelymitra
intro: Spiranthes trilineata var. thelymitra, commonly known as Thelymitra, is a type of terrestrial orchid native to Australia and New Zealand. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include relief from anxiety, insomnia, and stress. The health benefits of Thelymitra include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Thelymitra include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, including its sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory effects.
